summary: Batch 36: Loyalty Tier Engine v2 testing completed. All 12 backend tests passed (2 skipped due to no guest profiles with IDs in default property). Frontend panel fully functional with all tabs, tier ladder, KPI stats, batch eval, and history working correctly. Regression tests for pricing-explain and hk-turnover panels passed.

minor.issue: Batch eval 'evaluated' count includes guests without 'id' field who are silently skipped. Consider returning 'skipped_no_id' count for transparency.

critical_code_review_comments: loyalty_tier.py is well-structured with clear separation of config, evaluation, manual override, and dashboard endpoints
Auto-seeding of 5 default tiers (member/bronze/silver/gold/platinum) works correctly on first GET
Manual override correctly sets source='manual' and auto-eval respects this by skipping
History audit trail is maintained with last 50 entries per guest
Frontend LoyaltyTierPanel.js has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loyalty Tier Engine v2 is fully functional. Backend endpoints: GET/POST config, POST evaluate (single/batch), POST/DELETE manual override, GET guest tier, GET dashboard. Frontend panel has 3 tabs: Tier Distribution (ladder view), Config Editor, History. Batch eval processed 46 guests with 41 counted (5 skipped due to missing id field). Manual overrides are respected during auto-eval. Regression tests for pricing-explain and hk-turnover panels passed.

backend: GET /api/loyalty-tier/dashboard/{property_id} - returns stats + distribution + recent upgrades
Invalid tier_key in manual override returns 400
frontend: Sidebar 'Tier Engine v2' button (data-testid=loyalty-tier-btn) opens panel
KPI stats render (data-testid=lt-stats) - shows total members, manual overrides, recent activity, tier count
Tier ladder visible (data-testid=lt-ladder) with all 5 tier cards (lt-tier-{key})
